summary: 40-foot L-4 lookout built about 1934 in Boundary County; 1954 staff Ronald W. Moore; removed or destroyed about 1962; sources conflict on last use.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed about 1962; the register says removed and the other sources say destroyed. No source describes a standing structure.

access.note: On Kaniksu National Forest land. No source says the site is closed. None describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in. No source gives a route.

events.note: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built about 1934 (register, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts).
Burglary of the lookout reported in a Northern Idaho News item dated September 29, 1939. The item says groceries were taken on September 14.
Ronald W. Moore stationed at the lookout in July 1954, when Kaniksu lookouts at Roman Nose and Bald Eagle were activated for the season (Sandpoint News-Bulletin).
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed about 1962. Register says removed about 1962. A June 21, 1962 report says the towers were being toppled and burned.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed about 1962. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed about 1962. A June 21, 1962 report says the towers were being toppled and burned. The record keeps 1962 and reports both words.

The June 21, 1962 report says the towers had not been used or maintained since 1950. A July 1954 report on the same page says the Bald Eagle lookout was activated that year with Ronald W. Moore stationed there. The sources do not resolve this, so the story leaves the last year of use open.

notes_for_editor: Brief had no design or height; added L-4 and 12.2 m from the 40-foot pole figure (40 ft = 12.19 m). The register page has the typo 'removeded' in its source text. The Idaho Fire Lookouts Bald Eagle page also carries a 1974 account about Eagle Peak, a different lookout on Eagle Mountain; it is not used here. The 1939 burglary item names two men; the story does not name them. The 1962 report concerns six lookouts, not only Bald Eagle. Last use is unresolved: 1950 per the 1962 report, 1954 activation per the 1954 item.
